title: 新加坡大士南焚化廠~Singapore Tuas South Incineration Plant
focus: 既有焚化廠延役與性能維持~Life extension and performance retention of an incinerator
summary: 以大士南設備更新為案例，學習把鍋爐、吹灰、灰渣輸送、煙氣處理與起重設備視為相互依賴的系統；延役須有性能證據。~Using Tuas South refurbishment, treat boilers, soot blowing, ash transport, gas cleaning and cranes as interdependent systems; life extension requires performance evidence.

units.title: 進料品質基線：垃圾熱值與熱輸入~Feed-quality baseline: Waste heating value and heat input
units.mechanism: 熱輸入由垃圾質量流率及低位熱值決定；水分、惰性物與可燃成分會使同噸數產生不同熱量。本單元在「進料品質基線」觀察此因果關係。~Heat input depends on waste mass flow and lower heating value; moisture, inert material and combustibles change energy at the same tonnage. Examine this relationship at feed-quality baseline.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：m=10 t/h、LHV=8 MJ/kg。公式 Pthermal=m LHV/3.6；代入 10*8/3.6 = 22.22222 MW。適用邊界：熱輸入示範，不是爐體操作限值或爐排設計。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: m=10 t/h andLHV=8 MJ/kg. Formula Pthermal=m LHV/3.6; substitution 10*8/3.6 = 22.22222 MW. Boundary: Heat-input example, not a furnace operating limit or grate design.
units.verify: 以代表性混合樣估熱值，核對秤重與蒸汽生成趨勢。在離線場景為「進料品質基線」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Estimate heating value from representative composite samples and compare weighbridge and steam trends. Build an offline evidence table for feed-quality baseline; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 高含水垃圾可使熱值下降；只依噸數預測發電會偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Wet waste reduces heating value; tonnage alone mispredicts power. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 相同垃圾噸數必定產生相同熱量。~Equal waste tonnage always provides equal heat.
units.practice: 先點選「進料品質基線」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把LHV改成6 MJ/kg，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 16.66667 MW。與基準 22.22222 MW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the feed-quality baseline measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only LHV to6 MJ/kg with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 16.66667 MW. Compare with baseline 22.22222 MW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 更新鍋爐熱量帳：蒸汽焓差與鍋爐熱量~Refurbished boiler duty: Steam enthalpy rise and boiler duty
units.mechanism: 鍋爐將水的焓提高到蒸汽狀態；應用焓差而不是單靠出口溫度計算熱量。本單元在「更新鍋爐熱量帳」觀察此因果關係。~A boiler raises feedwater enthalpy to steam conditions; use enthalpy difference rather than outlet temperature alone. Examine this relationship at refurbished boiler duty.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：蒸汽流率5 kg/s、蒸汽與給水焓差2400 kJ/kg。公式 Psteam=m Δh/1000；代入 5*2400/1000 = 12 MW。適用邊界：假想查表焓值已給定；未含排污、蒸汽品質與非穩態。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: steam flow5 kg/s and steam-to-feedwater enthalpy rise2400 kJ/kg. Formula Psteam=m Δh/1000; substitution 5*2400/1000 = 12 MW. Boundary: Hypothetical tabulated enthalpy difference supplied; blowdown, quality and transients excluded.
units.verify: 使用同時壓力、溫度與流量，從蒸汽表核對焓狀態。在離線場景為「更新鍋爐熱量帳」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Use concurrent pressure, temperature and flow and check enthalpy states in steam tables. Build an offline evidence table for refurbished boiler duty; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 將飽和與過熱蒸汽混用會算錯能量。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Mixing saturated and superheated states gives an incorrect energy balance. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 蒸汽溫度相同就表示焓與功率也相同。~Equal steam temperature implies equal enthalpy and power.
units.practice: 先點選「更新鍋爐熱量帳」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把蒸汽流率改成4 kg/s，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 9.6 MW。與基準 12 MW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the refurbished boiler duty measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only steam flow to4 kg/s with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 9.6 MW. Compare with baseline 12 MW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 延役前後淨效率：淨發電效率~Pre/post-refit net efficiency: Net electrical efficiency
units.mechanism: 效率必須明確寫出有用輸出與能量輸入；電效率與含供熱的總效率不可直接比較。本單元在「延役前後淨效率」觀察此因果關係。~Efficiency needs explicit useful-output and energy-input definitions; electrical and heat-inclusive efficiencies are not directly comparable. Examine this relationship at pre/post-refit net efficiency.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：熱輸入30 MW、總發電8 MW、廠用1 MW。公式 ηnet=100(Pgross-Paux)/Pfuel；代入 100*(8-1)/30 = 23.33333 %。適用邊界：穩態低位熱值基準；不含供熱信用與生命週期排放。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: thermal input30 MW, gross electricity8 MW and auxiliaries1 MW. Formula ηnet=100(Pgross-Paux)/Pfuel; substitution 100*(8-1)/30 = 23.33333 %. Boundary: Steady lower-heating-value basis; heat credit and life-cycle emissions excluded.
units.verify: 以共同時窗核對燃料熱值、總發電與廠用負載。在離線場景為「延役前後淨效率」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Reconcile fuel heating value, gross generation and auxiliaries over one interval. Build an offline evidence table for pre/post-refit net efficiency; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 用高位熱值輸入搭配低位熱值比較值會錯置效率。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Mixing higher- and lower-heating-value bases distorts comparisons. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 總發電量就是淨輸出電量。~Gross generation equals net electricity output.
units.practice: 先點選「延役前後淨效率」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把廠用改成1.5 MW，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 21.66667 %。與基準 23.33333 %比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the pre/post-refit net efficiency measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only auxiliaries to1.5 MW with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 21.66667 %. Compare with baseline 23.33333 % and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 煙氣除塵可用面積：袋濾器氣布比~Available gas-cleaning area: Fabric-filter air-to-cloth ratio
units.mechanism: 氣布比是體積流量除以濾布面積；積塵層能提高捕集但也增加壓差。本單元在「煙氣除塵可用面積」觀察此因果關係。~Air-to-cloth ratio is gas flow divided by fabric area; a dust cake improves capture while increasing pressure drop. Examine this relationship at available gas-cleaning area.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：實際氣量Q=60000 m³/h、有效濾布A=1000 m²。公式 v=Q/(60A)；代入 60000/(60*1000) = 1 m/min。適用邊界：採實際溫度氣量，不可直接把Nm³當m³；非設備選型限值。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: actual gasQ=60000 m³/h and active clothA=1000 m². Formula v=Q/(60A); substitution 60000/(60*1000) = 1 m/min. Boundary: Use actual-temperature gas volume, not Nm³ directly; not a filter sizing limit.
units.verify: 按隔室紀錄壓差、脈衝與排放趨勢，查破袋或離線面積。在離線場景為「煙氣除塵可用面積」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Log compartment pressure drop, pulses and emissions and check broken bags or offline area. Build an offline evidence table for available gas-cleaning area; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 濾袋破損可能讓壓差下降同時排放上升。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~A torn bag can lower pressure drop while increasing emissions. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 壓差越低就保證除塵越好。~Lower pressure drop guarantees better dust capture.
units.practice: 先點選「煙氣除塵可用面積」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有效濾布降成800 m²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 1.25 m/min。與基準 1 m/min比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the available gas-cleaning area measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only active cloth to800 m² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 1.25 m/min. Compare with baseline 1 m/min and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 排放質量與有效資料：煙氣濃度與排放質量~Emission mass and valid data: Flue-gas concentration and emission mass
units.mechanism: 排放質量率取決於濃度乘氣體體積流率；濕乾基、氧校正與標準狀態必須一致。本單元在「排放質量與有效資料」觀察此因果關係。~Emission mass rate is concentration times gas flow; wet/dry basis, oxygen correction and standard conditions must agree. Examine this relationship at emission mass and valid data.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：C=20 mg/Nm³、乾基Q=100000 Nm³/h，兩者同基準。公式 M=CQ/1000000；代入 20*100000/1000000 = 2 kg/h。適用邊界：同基準的示範排放帳；不是任何地區法定排放限值。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: C=20 mg/Nm³ and dryQ=100000 Nm³/h on the same basis. Formula M=CQ/1000000; substitution 20*100000/1000000 = 2 kg/h. Boundary: Same-basis illustrative emissions ledger, not a statutory limit.
units.verify: 同步氣量、濃度與氧含量，查校正狀態及無效資料標記。在離線場景為「排放質量與有效資料」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Synchronize gas flow, concentration and oxygen while checking calibration and invalid-data flags. Build an offline evidence table for emission mass and valid data; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 稀釋煙氣可降濃度卻不降污染質量。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Diluting flue gas lowers concentration without lowering pollutant mass. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 只要濃度下降，排放總質量必定下降。~Lower concentration necessarily means lower emitted mass.
units.practice: 先點選「排放質量與有效資料」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把氣量改成120000 Nm³/h，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 2.4 kg/h。與基準 2 kg/h比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the emission mass and valid data measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only gas flow to120000 Nm³/h with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 2.4 kg/h. Compare with baseline 2 kg/h and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 灰渣輸送介面：灰渣分流與質量帳~Ash-conveyance interface: Ash-stream separation and mass balance
units.mechanism: 底渣與飛灰來源、污染物分布及處置需求不同，必須分流記錄；金屬回收不等於殘渣自動合格。本單元在「灰渣輸送介面」觀察此因果關係。~Bottom ash and fly ash differ in origin, contaminant distribution and management needs; keep separate ledgers, and metal recovery does not automatically certify residues. Examine this relationship at ash-conveyance interface.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：垃圾100 t/d、假想底渣分率0.20、飛灰分率0.03。公式 Mash=Mw(fbottom+ffly)；代入 100*(0.20+0.03) = 23 t/d。適用邊界：假想濕乾基一致的分率，非實際廠產率；須另考慮添加劑與水分。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: waste100 t/d, assumed bottom-ash fraction0.20 and fly-ash fraction0.03. Formula Mash=Mw(fbottom+ffly); substitution 100*(0.20+0.03) = 23 t/d. Boundary: Hypothetical consistent moisture basis, not actual plant yield; additives and moisture require separate entries.
units.verify: 各物流秤重並採代表性樣品，維持處置聯單與品質資料。在離線場景為「灰渣輸送介面」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Weigh each stream, take representative samples and retain disposal and quality records. Build an offline evidence table for ash-conveyance interface; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 混合底渣飛灰會失去追蹤與適切處理的依據。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Mixing bottom and fly ash loses traceability and treatment distinctions. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 焚化後所有固體都消失，不需後續管理。~Incineration eliminates all solids and subsequent management.
units.practice: 先點選「灰渣輸送介面」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把垃圾量改成120 t/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 27.6 t/d。與基準 23 t/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the ash-conveyance interface measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only waste to120 t/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 27.6 t/d. Compare with baseline 23 t/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 更新後廠用電：淨電力與廠用負載~Post-refit auxiliaries: Net electricity and auxiliary loads
units.mechanism: 能源自給須以同一邊界比較可用發電與所有廠用電；年度淨額不代表每小時離網。本單元在「更新後廠用電」觀察此因果關係。~Energy self-sufficiency compares usable generation and all internal loads within one boundary; an annual net balance does not prove hourly islanded operation. Examine this relationship at post-refit auxiliaries.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：發電5000 kWh/d、曝氣2800、泵600、其他400 kWh/d。公式 Enet=Eg-Ea-Ep-Eother；代入 5000-2800-600-400 = 1200 kWh/d。適用邊界：示範日帳，未含備援燃料與尖峰電力容量。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: generation5000 kWh/d, aeration2800, pumping600 and other loads400 kWh/d. Formula Enet=Eg-Ea-Ep-Eother; substitution 5000-2800-600-400 = 1200 kWh/d. Boundary: Illustrative daily ledger; reserve fuel and peak power capacity are omitted.
units.verify: 核對發電、購電與售電表，在相同邊界做全年帳。在離線場景為「更新後廠用電」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Reconcile generation, imports and exports within the same boundary over a year. Build an offline evidence table for post-refit auxiliaries; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 漏掉臭氣處理與污泥設備用電會誇大淨盈餘。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Omitting odor and sludge equipment overstates net surplus. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 年發電量大於用電就證明完全不用外電。~Annual generation above demand proves no grid imports are needed.
units.practice: 先點選「更新後廠用電」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把曝氣用電提高到3500 kWh/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 500 kWh/d。與基準 1200 kWh/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the post-refit auxiliaries measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only aeration demand to3500 kWh/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 500 kWh/d. Compare with baseline 1200 kWh/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 新舊儀表一致性：感測器偏移校正~Old/new sensor consistency: Sensor offset calibration
units.mechanism: 參考標準可辨識偏移；一點校正只能處理固定偏移，斜率誤差須多點標準確認。本單元在「新舊儀表一致性」觀察此因果關係。~A reference reveals offset; one-point correction handles only a constant offset, whereas gain error needs several standards. Examine this relationship at old/new sensor consistency.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：參考值10.0、感測器10.8、樣品原讀值14.2，單位一致。公式 Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference)；代入 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit。適用邊界：假設偏移固定且量程線性；不代替多點校正與漂移追蹤。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: reference10.0, sensor10.8 and raw sample14.2 in the same units. Formula Ccorrected=Craw-(Cstandard_read-Creference); substitution 14.2-(10.8-10.0) = 13.4 sensor unit. Boundary: Constant offset and linear range assumed; multi-point calibration and drift tracking remain necessary.
units.verify: 用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「新舊儀表一致性」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for old/new sensor consistency; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 單點校正可以證明整個量程都沒有誤差。~One-point calibration proves the entire range is error-free.
units.practice: 先點選「新舊儀表一致性」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把樣品原讀值改成16.2，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15.4 sensor unit。與基準 13.4 sensor unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the old/new sensor consistency measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only raw sample to16.2 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15.4 sensor unit. Compare with baseline 13.4 sensor unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 分期停爐能力：備援與共同失效~Phased shutdown capacity: Redundancy and common failures
units.mechanism: 平行備援可降低獨立停機造成的服務中斷，但共同電源、進水或控制器會破壞獨立假設。本單元在「分期停爐能力」觀察此因果關係。~Parallel redundancy reduces outages from independent failures, but common power, feed or controllers invalidate independence. Examine this relationship at phased shutdown capacity.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：兩列各自可用率A=0.95且任一列足以供應示範負載。公式 Asys=1-(1-A)^2；代入 1-(1-0.95)**2 = 0.9975 fraction。適用邊界：僅兩列獨立且容量足夠；不含共同失效或修復時間分布。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: two trains each have availabilityA=0.95 and either meets the hypothetical load. Formula Asys=1-(1-A)^2; substitution 1-(1-0.95)**2 = 0.9975 fraction. Boundary: Two independent adequate-capacity trains only; common failures and repair-time distributions are excluded.
units.verify: 畫故障樹並標出共享設備，測試單列退出時的完整流程。在離線場景為「分期停爐能力」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Draw a fault tree marking shared assets and replay the process with one train unavailable. Build an offline evidence table for phased shutdown capacity; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 兩列共用一個關鍵閥門，該閥失效仍會同時停產。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~A shared critical valve can stop both trains together. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 設備數量加倍就能消除所有停機。~Doubling equipment eliminates every outage.
units.practice: 先點選「分期停爐能力」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把各列A改成0.90，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.99 fraction。與基準 0.9975 fraction比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the phased shutdown capacity measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only each train availability to0.90 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.99 fraction. Compare with baseline 0.9975 fraction and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

units.title: 氣候與垃圾組成對照：前後與對照地點比較~Weather/composition controls: Before-after and control comparison
units.mechanism: 干預前後差異還可能包含天氣與背景趨勢；前後—對照差分可分離共同變化但仍須檢查可比性。本單元在「氣候與垃圾組成對照」觀察此因果關係。~Before-after changes include weather and background trends; difference-in-differences removes common changes but still needs comparable sites. Examine this relationship at weather/composition controls.
units.model: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：處理地由30降至27，對照地由29降至28，同一指標。公式 effect=(Tafter-Tbefore)-(Cafter-Cbefore)；代入 (27-30)-(28-29) = -2 indicator unit。適用邊界：假設共同背景趨勢；不是隨機試驗或完全因果證明。~Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: treated site30 to27 and control site29 to28 for the same indicator. Formula effect=(Tafter-Tbefore)-(Cafter-Cbefore); substitution (27-30)-(28-29) = -2 indicator unit. Boundary: Common background trend assumed; not a randomized trial or complete causal proof.
units.verify: 採同期多日資料並檢查前期趨勢，不選只對結果有利的一天。在離線場景為「氣候與垃圾組成對照」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。~Use simultaneous multi-day data, inspect pre-trends and avoid selecting a favorable day. Build an offline evidence table for weather/composition controls; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
units.failure: 處理地同時換交通流量會讓單一干預歸因失真。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。~Concurrent traffic changes at the treated site confound attribution. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
units.misconception: 前後改變全都必定由這一項工程造成。~Every before-after change must be caused by this project.
units.practice: 先點選「氣候與垃圾組成對照」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把對照地事後值改成27，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 -1 indicator unit。與基準 -2 indicator unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。~Select the weather/composition controls measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only control-after to27 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute -1 indicator unit. Compare with baseline -2 indicator unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.
